stem.en: In an earthquake, rock breaks 15 km underground. What is the epicentre?

text.en: The place underground where the rock breaks

feedback.en: No. That place is the focus.

text.en: The whole line of the fault across the land

feedback.en: No. The epicentre is one point, not a line.

text.en: The town with the worst damage, wherever it is

feedback.en: No. The epicentre is fixed by position, not by damage.

text.en: The point on the surface straight above it

feedback.en: Yes. The epicentre lies directly above the focus.

explanation.en: The focus is where the rock breaks underground. The epicentre is the point on the surface straight above the focus. Shaking is often strongest near it, but the word names a position.

hints.en: Is the epicentre underground or on the surface?
Which word names the place of the break itself?
